item.title: Daily Risk Brief — November 7, 2026
item.description:
• UKMTO 197: time-late report of an explosion at the waterline of a tanker outbound through Hormuz (UKMTO)
  • US Mission Saudi Arabia security alert urging heightened vigilance over Houthi and Iranian targeting threats (US Mission)
  • Hoax bomb threats again disrupt European flights and some newsrooms; no explosives found in reported cases
  • US Ebola attestation remains in force; Nigeria guidance updates where confirmed (CDC / US Embassy)

Tueri summarizes public reporting. Not legal, medical, or security advice for a specific situation. Check the original source before you act.

item.title: Daily Risk Brief — November 1, 2026

  • FCDO: Galapagos regional emergency after Santa Cruz flooding, with road, power, and Baltra airport access disruption (FCDO / US Embassy)
  • US Embassy Moscow warned of a credible mass-casualty threat at a large museum park; Russian media say the site was closed (US Embassy / media)
  • UKMTO: large fishing vessel boarded off the Horn of Africa; concern it could support a pirate action group (UKMTO)

item.title: Daily Risk Brief — October 31, 2026
item.description:
• UKMTO: vessel hit by an unknown projectile about 40 NM off Iran inside the Arabian Gulf; fire reported, crew safe (UKMTO)
  • US Embassy Honduras security alert on a reported threat to bridges and access around Puerto Cortes; Honduran minister says it may be a false alarm
  • Mayon volcano raised to alert level three after an explosive eruption; 6 km danger zone evacuation recommended (PHIVOLCS via embassy/media)
  • FCDO: violence around Moyale affects the Ethiopia-Kenya border crossing; stay on the main A2 if crossing (FCDO)

  • Houthi claim of multiple Saudi airport and oil-facility attacks remains claim only; coalition reports intercepts (Houthi / coalition)
  • Madrid to Andalusia high-speed replacement service not expected before Tuesday Nov 3; line still closed (Renfe via reporting)
